releases.notes:
**Download the one file for your Minecraft version and loader**, for example `desktopscreens-fabric-1.21.1-0.3.2.jar` for Fabric 1.21.1. Fabric needs Fabric API. Windows 10 (version 2004 or newer) and Windows 11. Also on CurseForge: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/desktop-screens

**VR with Vivecraft** (every version except 1.12.2):

- Point at your screen and pull the trigger to start using it, no key needed. With "VR screens: In the world", that same pull already clicks where you point. With the Screen Builder in hand, the trigger works on screens as before.
- The trigger no longer breaks your own screen while it's on. To take it down, turn it off first with the use button, or use the Screen Builder.
- The hints about a screen ("[Trigger] Use the screen", "[Use button] Turn on") show at the screen instead of on your wrist.

**Changes on every version:**

- Picture-in-picture goes up to 75 % of the game window's width. A new choice on its page, "Hotbar: Below the picture", keeps a big picture above the hotbar.
- A menu that opens past the edge of a one-window picture shows: the picture zooms out while it's open, and the mouse can reach it.

**1.12.2:** picture-in-picture goes up to 75 % with the new Hotbar choice, and in the desktop view a menu past the edge of a one-window picture shows.

Please report bugs here on GitHub: https://github.com/MagiMigi/desktop-screens/issues

releases.notes:
**Download the one file for your Minecraft version and loader**, for example `desktopscreens-fabric-1.21.1-0.3.1.jar` for Fabric 1.21.1. Fabric needs Fabric API. Windows 10 (version 2004 or newer) and Windows 11. Also on CurseForge: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/desktop-screens

**VR with Vivecraft** (every version except 1.12.2):

- Commands without a keyboard: a bar under the desktop on the VR panel has Picture-in-picture, One window, Next monitor, Settings and Back to the game. For picture-in-picture and one window, click the button, then the window.
- The Tablet opens the desktop on the VR panel too.
- New: **VR screens: In the world** (in the settings). Point at the screen itself instead of using the panel: the trigger clicks, the use button right-clicks, the right stick scrolls, Vivecraft's keyboard types, and the menu button takes you back. The bar floats under the screen (over it, when the screen stands on the floor). It's new, so please tell us how it works for you.
- Picture-in-picture shows on Vivecraft's HUD, where the hotbar is. To have it in front of you, set Vivecraft's HUD Orientation Lock to Head.
- Hints point at the bar's buttons instead of Right Ctrl keys, and the settings fit on Vivecraft's panel.

**Changes on every version:**

- Picture-in-picture can be pinned without a Tablet. It shows while you carry one.
- The border's thickness, color and rainbow speed are on their own page in the settings: Border, Edit...
- A screen showing one window shows that window's menus and dropdowns while you use it.

**1.12.2:** picture-in-picture can be pinned without a Tablet, and the Tablet and the Screen Builder no longer have ".name" at the end of their names.

Please report bugs here on GitHub: https://github.com/MagiMigi/desktop-screens/issues

releases.notes:
**Download the one file for your Minecraft version and loader**, for example `desktopscreens-fabric-1.21.1-0.3.0.jar` for Fabric 1.21.1. Fabric needs Fabric API. Windows 10 (version 2004 or newer) and Windows 11. Also on CurseForge: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/desktop-screens

**VR with Vivecraft** (every version except 1.12.2; Vivecraft 1.3 or newer):

- Use a screen with your controllers: "Use the screen" shows your desktop on Vivecraft's floating panel, the same picture as on the screen in the world.
- Point with the laser to move your mouse cursor. The trigger clicks; right-click and scrolling are on the same buttons as in your inventory.
- Vivecraft's keyboard types into your PC. The menu button takes you back to the game.
- Put "Use the screen" on a controller button once, in SteamVR's controller settings for Minecraft (the Mod section).
- Vivecraft's "Double GUI Resolution" setting makes the desktop on the panel sharper.
- Seated VR (no controllers) uses your mouse and keyboard, as on a PC.
- VR support is new: please tell us what works and what doesn't.

**Changes on every version:**

- Hints show again whenever you look back at a screen, or at another part of it with the Screen Builder in hand (like "Resize" near an edge).
- Turning a screen on says who sees it: "Screen on: it shows your desktop to you and anyone you share it with".

Please report bugs here on GitHub: https://github.com/MagiMigi/desktop-screens/issues
